result.description: AuroraSpan is a fictional server memory module designed for dense database appliances, virtualization nodes, and fault-tolerant compute systems. It uses DDR5 ECC registered architecture with a 64GB capacity and a 5600 MT/s data rate, targeting platforms that prioritize stability over gaming or graphics performance. The module is presented as a low-profile DIMM for rack-mounted servers and workstation boards that support registered memory.
result.title: AuroraSpan 64GB DDR5-5600 ECC Registered Memory Module
